question: Where are a hotel positioned within 100 kilometers relative to Denver Health Medical Center Emergency Department Trauma Center, Denver, CO in the northwest direction?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Denver Health Medical Center Emergency Department Trauma Center%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 100000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Denver Health Medical Center Emergency Department Trauma Center%' LIMIT 1 ), pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;
